notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

Version 1.1.0, has been applied.🎉
Don't miss out on the weekly discounts that started with the update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487680

This update adds a new Endless Mode along with many balance changes, including renewal of building mechanics. 🤗 From now on, I will tell you the details.




🚀Patch Highlights

Balance
Many balance improvements have been made to improve the overall game experience. Especially for the building, many renewal works have been applied.

There are a variety of buildings in the game, but in the past, in most situations, it was often the case that the game continued for a long time with one building that was liked. Now, special effects have been added to the buildings to further enhance the individuality and characteristics of each building, and new combinations can be tried through synergy effects with other buildings.

In addition to adjusting the performance of modules with excessively high efficiency, we have adjusted the performance of later modules to enable strategic selection based on performance. Now, higher tier modules may not always be the better choice, and depending on your building's combination and technology tree, lower tier modules can also be used strategically.

The range of ranged monsters has been adjusted to be more consistent so that ranged monsters do not become overly difficult towards the later stages of the game. Additionally, the activation interval of most field objects has been adjusted to be longer than before.

Level Design
To increase strategic freedom, unbuildable terrain has been reduced overall.

New Endless Mode
A new and improved Endless Mode has been added.
You can play stages endlessly and earn badges and rewards based on the highest level you reach.



📜v.1.1.0 Full Patch Notes

New content: Endless Mode
A new Endless Mode has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/d3f4ee55c724e3cfb2e5b3a69c1b75c3037e49ab.png

The new Endless Mode gives players a clear goal. Instead of the traditional method, you can now only receive badges and rewards once by completing certain stages. Even if you've achieved all badges, you can always play your favorite stages to the limit in Endless Mode.

Level design improvements
Unbuildable terrain has been reduced overall, and the terrain of some stages has been modified.

Improvements

 “x0.0 speed” has been added to the game speed settings.
 Hovering over a building under attack now displays the target.
 The “Mute sound in background” setting has been added to the [General] tab of the settings screen.
 Monsters now move more consistently in the same situation.

Dear Users!
This is the Broken Universe development team.

Version 1.0.7, has arrived.

In this update, fusion and Operation improvements, 3rd Sub-chapter balance adjustments, and major bug fixes have been made. 😆
Fusion Towers no longer require building enhancement requirements. Previously, even if the building required for fusion was unlocked, there was a wait to raise 4 more levels to enhance, but now the fusion tower can be used immediately after the building required for fusion is unlocked. In addition, each Operation can be selected and played without a date limit, and the number of times that can be played has also increased.

notes.title: Official Release Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

Broken Universe is officially released!🎉🎉

To commemorate the official release, a 20% discount will be held for a week, so please look forward to it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487680

The 1.0 update, which coincides with this official release, includes tons of new content, including new Chapters, new Operation, Expanded Armory, new buildings and fusion towers, new skills, and new skins. 🤩😆 Here we introduce the details of the update.



🚀Update Highlights

New Chapters
The 9th main chapter and the 3rd sub-chapter have been newly added. Challenge yourself to colorful and suspenseful stages on a unique new planet.

New Operation
A new operation "Troy" has been added. Destroy Troy by dealing with monsters spraying out of Troy. If successful, many parts can be obtained as rewards.

New Content: Renovation
Renovate the strengthened building to make it even stronger. Modifications require parts, cores, or dimension stones.

New Content: Expanded Armory
Meet the ever-expanding arsenal of Paca joining the ship. 10 new weapons have been added and new weapons can be modified.

Endless Mode Deleted
We deleted the endless mode that made the existing gameplay flow boring and focused on developing various contents.

Level Design Improvements
Level design has been improved across all chapters. Various improvements have been made to reduce the complexity of the game and make the game more fun to play.

Various Additional Elements
Discover new buildings, new fusion towers, new skills, new skins and new rewards.

Balance
Rewards have been strengthened and resource requirements have been adjusted in many areas. In addition, in accordance with the addition of new buildings, we have reinforced the balance of buildings that were difficult to use in the past and applied special additional effects so that the "Energy Cube" skill can be used more diversely. In addition to this, we have weakened the attack power of large monsters so that they can respond more easily.

Hidden Content
Play new content and face new challenges.

Strategy Sketch
Sketch your strategy on the screen through the strategy sketch function. You can use the function at any time before or after starting the game, and the game will be paused during the game.

Translation
Spanish has been added.



📜v.1.0.0 Patch Node

New Chapters
The 9th main chapter and the last main chapter leading to the ending "Flox" and the 3rd sub-chapter "Delicia" have been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/22cd18411da4049b855cdf3689e83072bec96f17.png

The terrifying volcanic planet Flox includes 9 main stages and 9 special stages.
Each stage consists of 10 different stages in Delicia.
Enjoy a variety of challenges on a unique new planet.

New Operation
A new operation "Troy" has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/ce316da41c8b0c5edbd6f3f1faceee43756f765f.png

Troy Operation is a content where many parts can be obtained as rewards, and a Trojan Horse appears instead of a monster portal. Monsters jump out of the Trojan Horse and land in unpredictable locations. Destroy all Trojan horses within the time limit to complete the mission.

New Content: Renovation
A Renovation content has been added.
Renovation is content that can further strengthen buildings and weapons and is activated when Chapter 4 is cleared.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/8294b8fe26628c915fb6eb154b1d072e513ae71a.jpg

Renovation requires a lot of parts, cores or dimension stones, and must be fully enhanced.
Push the performance of your building to the limit through renovation.

New Content: Expanded Armory
A Expanded Armory content has been added.
Now, after clearing Chapter 6, the armory will expand and you will be able to purchase 10 new weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/a9a70ee989d8bf99a7117c1baad52bc31c573da5.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/32c3972a70ccff229584ee630e33a6468aac66dc.png

Dear Users!
This is the Broken Universe development team.

Version 0.12.7, has arrived.

In this update, various additional functions have been added and numerous balance adjustments have been made, with a focus on expanding building slots and improving Normal difficulty. From now on, we will deliver the contents. 😊

Building slots have been greatly expanded from 8 to a maximum of 12! 🤗 The 9th new slot is provided by default, and the 10th slot can be unlocked using gold. In addition, a new building setting that allows you to set the default target mode of each building has been added, and you can attach any nickname you want to the building, skill, item, or tech-tree deck. ⚙ In addition, a damage statistic panel has been added that can be checked during the game. 📊

Normal difficulty has been revamped and is now easier. 📗 Monsters now have a reduced quantity on Normal difficulty and the abilities of tricky monsters are disabled. You can also use one more item using the new extra item slot. 💣 Items used in extra item slots are permanently consumed.

Operations can now be played twice a day. ✅ In addition, if you clear the sub-chapter on Hard difficulty, a skin that can be purchased has been added, so you can meet two new skins. The difficulty of Exploration and Operation has also been adjusted as a whole, and the maximum difficulty of Operation has been expanded by 5 levels.

A number of building balances have been reworked, with a focus on allowing more variety of buildings to be utilized. The anti-recovery ability has been removed from the 'High Frequency Generator', and the anti-recovery ability has been added to various buildings. In addition, a new building with the effect of lowering the defense of the building has been added, and some towers have a function that gives additional damage to the shield, which can be used anew. Mine items have also been added anti-recovery and armor-reducing abilities, allowing you to experiment with more combinations with buildings. Finally, the Challenge Mode that is too difficult has been rebalanced.

notes.title: Price Change Notification
notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

As announced last week, the price of the game will soon be changed to the official price of $9.99.
The changed price will be reflected within a few days. In some countries, prices may increase even more.



While preparing the full version, we are preparing updates for the following items in the meantime.

Increase Number of Building Slots
There are currently 8 building slots. It is an increase from the initial 6, but as a fusion tower updated with a new tower, the need for various building combinations increased even more. The current number of slots is not enough to use various buildings and fusion towers, which reduce fun of game. Therefore, we are looking for ways to expand the number of building slots to 10 or 12 without harming the UI.

Decreased Difficulty in Normal Mode
Currently, the only difference between Normal Mode and Hard Mode is the stats of the monsters, and there is no other difference. The stat difference is not small, but Normal Mode is still difficult. In Wild Mode, there is a slight difference in the progress of the game because the landing point is different along with the difference in stats, but the difference between Normal Mode and Hard Mode is not very close. Therefore, in Normal Mode, the following methods are applied to differentiate it from Hard Mode, while lowering the difficulty.

 Decrease the amount of monsters.
 Certain abilities of some monsters are disabled.
 The frequency of use of the boss' skill has been lowered.




The official release is scheduled for June and includes 9th Chapter and 3rd Sub-chapter, new Operations, Renovation content, expanded Armory content, new towers and fusion towers, new skills, and new skins.

Stay tuned until the official release. thank you! 💖

New Chapter
A new 8th main chapter has been added. Try new stages and new special missions in a unique chapter!

New content: Exploration
The new Exploration content is a highly difficult content where player play three completely random-generated stages in succession. Overcome unpredictable stages and conquer all areas!

New content: Operation
The Operation presented along with the Exploration is a comprehensive daily content collection of various contents, and player can meet two new operations in this update. Enjoy Precision Exploration to mine many rewards while fending off monsters in the dark, and Stronghold Defense where you can acquire pouring gold while blocking countless monsters that constantly come in.

New content: Armory
The Armory is a new shop selling small weapons that protect player's landing pod. Buy weapons from the Armory and keep your lading pod safe and secure!

Balance
By adjusting the balance of the buildings so that various buildings can be utilized, the balance of the modules has been further improved.

Improve Translations

In addition, you can meet a lot of additional content such as new skin modules and items.

New Exploration content has been added and can be played from the "Exploration" menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/2de62abcae8b9613c2844f0dae44a074f0bf8294.png

Exploration is a highly difficult content where player play three random-generated stages in succession, and player can receive many parts and cores as a reward.

Stages are completely randomized for each play, so player will encounter a different stage each time. In addition, there is a characteristic that the resources, power, and drones left from the previous stage are transferred to the next stage, and if destroyed, a special wall from which player can acquire resources and power appears.

As the main chapter progresses, new regions are opened together, and each region consists of 10 difficulty levels. Challenge the unpredictable stages of exploration!

New content: Operation
Operation content has been newly added and can be played from the "Exploration" menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/6773cc87d89f2c30449a4b51345306195ff7bec6.png

Operation is a comprehensive daily content consisting of various contents. There are two operations: 'Precision Exploration' and 'Stronghold Defense'.

Operations are opened alternately, one per day. If player fail to clear, player can continue to try again, but once player complete it, player cannot play again until the next open day. Therefore, it is recommended to play on the highest level of difficulty that can be cleared. As player progress through the main chapter, player can play on a higher level of difficulty.

Stages of all Operations are random-generated like Exploration, but the same stage appears on the same difficulty level for one day.

Precision Exploration
Precision Exploration is content that collects various additional rewards by blocking monsters on a stage covered in deep darkness.

By default, visibility is secured around monster portals and landing pod, and monsters in dark areas cannot be attacked, so you need to place multiple buildings to gain more visibility.

Also, there are walls where you can get gold, parts, and cores all over the field, and you can get many rewards by breaking these walls. However, if you fail to clear, you will lose all the rewards you have obtained.

Stronghold Defense
Stronghold Defense is content that collects as much gold as possible by holding out as long as possible.

You start with a lot of resources, but you can't mine any resources at all. Monsters don't drop resources either, but instead drop a lot of gold. As the phases pass, the monsters get stronger and more numerous, and each time you survive a phase, you acquire a certain amount of resources.

There is no failure in Stronghold Defense, and you can receive the gold obtained just before the lander is destroyed as a reward. Try to get as much gold as you can by holding on as long as possible.

Dear Users! Merry Christmas! 🎄
This is the Broken Universe development team.

Version 0.11.4, has arrived.

This update includes increase game optimization, max player level, balance adjustments, and various bug fixes. 😊

First, the overall optimization within the game has been improved, and a major bug where the attack animation plays but does not attack due to a bug between the attack animation and the game logic has been fixed.. Now the frustration will be a little less. 🤩 Also, the 'stun when attacking' effect was very strong, so instead of reducing this duration by half, we slightly increased the activation rate of the 'Stun' skill. And as the bug of the bounce effect was fixed, the attack power of the related building was adjusted. Lastly, the self-destruct monster no longer drops resources when it successfully self-destructs, and the effectiveness of the 'Power Recovery II' skill has been increased to further increase the efficiency of the Support category. 🛰

Next Update Plan
In addition to preparing for the update of the eighth main chapter and the third sub-chapter, what we are most concerned about right now is the 'Exploration' content. 🚀🧭 Exploration content is designed to be unlocked after clearing the second main chapter. And it is high-difficulty content played in succession through 3 randomly generated stages in a procedural method. ☠ Exploration content itself is a breakthrough content that can test yourself, but it is also content that can acquire a lot of resources. While player can get a lot of experience and gold in the Endless mode, player will be able to get a lot of parts and cores in the exploration content. Since the 'Armory' content to be added later will require a lot of resources, exploration content will be a good resource to acquire.

Dear Users!
This is the Broken Universe development team.

Version 0.11.2, has arrived.

This update includes 6 new buildings and UI improvements. 😊

In the past, there were various ways to deal with large monsters, but it was not easy to try because most of them required the use of complex strategies. In this update, buildings suitable for dealing with large monsters have been added, so player can try a little more variety. 🤗 In addition, a new support-type building that reduces the delay in the building has been added, and it is expected that the use of the support-type building will further increase. 😎

Next Update and Mobile Version
We are currently preparing a mobile version at the same time as preparing for the next update. The mobile version has the same contents as the PC version as much as possible, but is being prepared in a different direction in terms of service, etc. The mobile version is free of charge by default, but player can't play indefinitely because player will need additional Fuel each time player play a stage. In addition, the amount of EXP and other rewards supplied are less than the PC version, and some functions such as ranking content are not provided. notes.title: Update: v.0.11.1
notes.content:
Dear Users!
This is the Broken Universe development team.

Version 0.11.1, has arrived.

This update includes several game improvements, balance updates, and important bug fixes. 😊

First, the game clear effects has been improved to match the new game design, and various effects have been added, including the previously added boss of a new chapter.

Estimated monster path from portal to lander is now displayed with 'Monster Path Guide' turned on. Also, after all monsters appear, the number of remaining monsters is displayed in the mission panel at the top right of the screen. Even if you fail to complete a mission in the special stage, a UI appears that clearly informs you, so player can see why the stage failed. 😃

For beginners, a guide for various situations has also been added. In particular, if player do not perform a mission in the special stage, a guide will appear naturally to inform player. In addition, usable field elements and mission objectives were emphasized as effects. 🎆

First, in terms of balance, we reduced the construction cost of the fusion tower from 0+100 to 50+50. 💰 This will be especially noticeable on Hard difficulty and Endless mode. Next, we emphasized the characteristics of towers with high penetration, increasing the utility of towers with high penetration when monsters with high defense appeared, and lowered most of the level limits of new buildings that were previously added. In addition, we adjusted the cost of modules whose cost increase was too high compared to options, and increased the durability of wall items. Lastly, since the amount of rewards obtained from the 'Star Collecting' content was too high compared to the stage progress, we adjusted it to a lower level.

There are currently several ways to deal with large monsters in the game, but we recognize that most often require the use of multiple strategies, so only one or two specific strategies are used. A total of 6 new buildings will be added next week, including a new building and new fusion tower that is good for dealing with large monsters. 🤗

notes.title: Major Update: v.0.11.0
notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

The second major update, Version 0.11.0, has arrived.🎉🎉

In this major update, numerous adjustments have been made to the game as a whole, including content additions, level design reorganization, and balance adjustments. We'll give you more details from now on. 😎



🚀Patch Summary

New Chapters
The seventh main chapter "Aionios"❄⛄ and the second sub-chapter "Musica"🎼🎹 have been added.
Enjoy a new stage on the ice planet Aionios and the unique music planet Musica!

Level Design Overhaul
Overall, the game time is slightly increased, allowing you to play more comfortably than before, and "0.5x speed" has been added to the double speed function.
Also, the basic game mode has been changed from lasting a given amount of time to eliminating the last monster. Be careful, especially at the end, as there will be many monsters! 🛠🧱

New Buildings & Fusion Towers & Skills
4 types of buildings have been added up to level 25, and 6 types of fusion towers have also been added. 🏹🔫 Face more colorful monsters with new buildings with unique features.
4 skills have been added up to level 19. 🛰⚡💥

New Modules & Items
14 "Unique" grade modules and 6 "Rare" grade limited modules have been added, and a total of 13 items including 10 "4-star" grade items have been added. 🧩💣 New modules are powerful, but often require high resources. Discover your own recipes with new modules. A new mine item that deals damage to shields and stuns monsters has also been added.

Balance
Numerous balance adjustments have been made throughout the game along with the level design overhaul. 📐
Tower
The construction cost of fusion towers has increased significantly, most fusion towers have become more powerful, and the efficiency of debuff and support buildings has been significantly increased. Numerous tweaks have also been made to all buildings, including adding or enhancing traits to make them more versatile. Check out the details below.
Skills & Techs
The skills were so powerful that they could easily solve any situation, most of which weakened their performance. Instead, the cooldown has been reduced, and using techs from the support category can still be powerful.
In the mid-to-late game, there was a problem that the difficulty of the game was drastically lowered because the growth rate by tech research was very large, so various techs were adjusted.
Modules & Items
Most of the resources required for modules that increase firepower have been increased, and the options of various modules have been changed so that more diverse modules can be utilized. For items, the durability of wall items has been increased to make them more useful.
Monsters
By further strengthening the characteristics of the monsters in each chapter, it is difficult to solve all situations with only one type of building, and you can easily solve the stage by combining several buildings well. Generally, monsters with high movement speed have high resistance to a single attack, and monsters with high defense have high resistance to range attacks. In addition, player should pay attention to the various abilities of monsters, such as recovering life, avoiding attacks, and reducing damage.

A Whole New Translation
Completely new translations in English and Chinese. 📝

notes.title: v.0.11 Update Preview
notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

The second major update, version 0.11, is coming soon. 🚀🎉

This 0.11 update includes content updates throughout the game, including new chapters, new buildings and fusion towers, new skills, new modules and items, level design revamps and numerous balancing adjustments. 😊 We will introduce what we have prepared from now on.



New Chapters
The seventh main chapter “Aionios” and the second sub-chapter “Musica” will be added.
There are 24 new stages on the cold ice planet ❄⛄ and the ​​colorful music planet. 🎼🎹

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/83d380098d0ae247b746faab2e8e98e2f2ccb5dc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/84821b61372e63182fb497b55a57d17cbc1344f6.gif

Aionios' defensive monsters have a damage reduction effect, so it is difficult to deal with low damage such as sustained damage. In the special stage, you have to complete new missions while paying attention to ancient soldiers🧙‍♀️ with strong buff abilities.

In Musica's stage, monsters are strengthened with various effects, and many monsters have extra
 damage abilities, making it relatively difficult to withstand with a barrier. 😈 Also, be aware that the floor where buildings cannot be built has the effect of healing monsters. 🌈



Level Design Rework
The main objective of the game has been changed from "Survive for a given amount of time" to "Defeat all monsters", and the game time has been increased by 1 minute. In response, the entire level design has been overhauled and all over 80 stages have been reworked. 🛠🧱📐

Monsters appear continuously during the stage time, but appear at a more leisurely interval than before, especially in the last 10 to 15 seconds, a greater amount of monsters appear. After the time runs out, you must defeat all monsters to clear the stage. Additional missions must still be completed within the time limit.



New Buildings
4 new buildings and 6 new fusion towers will be added. 🏹🔫

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/2ef3e86b58c98a71c4d10427d3bc2df15258c324.png

New buildings have unique features that make them very powerful in certain situations. We expect that various strategies will appear along with the new buildings. Also, 3 of the existing buildings will be deleted to reduce complexity of game.



New Skills
Four new skills are added. 🛰⚡💥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/c6110b875074ef1fe592cba4e84d8c7e3e14440e.png

Most of the new skills are expensive to use, but they are powerful.



New modules
14 new "Unique" tier modules and 6 new limited edition modules with "Rare" tier will be added. 🧩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/3eea57138d8ecd7c242e9e823383f25818934a01.png

Unique tier modules can be obtained from the shop after clearing Chapter 6 or by synthesizing 3 Rare tier modules. Unique grade modules cause a very high cost increase when mounted on a building, but they often have a strong effect. New modules allow you to change the performance of buildings even more dramatically.

The new Rare tier limited edition module can be obtained as a clear reward for the new sub-chapter, Musica Stage.



New Items
A total of 13 new items will be added, including 10 items with a “4-star” tier. 💣

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/15b71feb7cd3b98c5fe0c1fab8ae9731996f784f.png

4-star tier items can be obtained from the shop after clearing Chapter 6 or by synthesizing 3-star tier items. In accordance with the level design rework, items used for monster portals have been deleted, and new mines with stun function have been added.



Translations and Other Improvements
English and Chinese are completely newly translated by a professional company. The Japanese language will be reflected in a future update. In addition, we plan to support users to add their own language files in a future update. 📝 This method uses ".csv" file format so anyone can edit it easily. It is possible to edit existing languages ​​as well as add new ones. However, the issue of whether these additional data will be officially reflected is not being considered at this time.

In addition, there are updates that will enhance the game's completeness, such as adding "x0.5 speed" in the game, improving water graphics, improving damage display visibility, and over 200 balance changes throughout the game, so please look forward to it. 😄



Future Plans
As we continue to improve and balance updates, the next major update, Update 0.12, also adds two new chapters. We are also preparing additional content such as "Exploration" and "Armory". Exploration are contents that clear randomly generated stages, and Armory are contents that equip landers with additional weapons. Update 0.12 is planned as the third major update and the last major update going into Early Access. The final ninth main chapter will be added with the official release.

Also, after the 0.11 update, the mobile version 📱 will be released soon. We hope to see Broken Universe on mobile soon! 😍



End
So far, we have shared with you about the 0.11 update and the plans for the next update. 🤗
We are always grateful to users who enjoy the game, and we will repay you with better content. 💖
Don't forget to give feedback too!

Thank you! 🌟

notes.title: Next Update Plans
notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

First of all, I would like to thank the users who enjoy the game for receiving a lot of feedback.
There are still a few important updates until the official release, but based on the feedback, many areas have been improved and many problems remain also.

The main updates we had planned until the official release were focused on content updates, but during the Early Access, we found that there were more problems with other parts than the amount of content. In particular, we are very aware of the problem of translation quality.

So, rather than proceeding with the 0.11 update quickly, we would like to proceed with the future update after making up for these parts as much as possible. Therefore, we will postpone the 0.11 update schedule to the end of next month and focus on the following areas.

Improve Level Design
The overall progress of the game is slowed down. This includes increasing the stage time by 1 minute, reducing the resource acquisition rate, and increasing the spawn interval of monsters.

Change Stage Clear Condition
After the last monster appears, player must defeat all monsters on the field to clear the stage. Currently, the game felt boring with little time remaining, and the fun of clearing the game was halved.

Improve Game Flow and Dialogue
The number of stages in Chapters 1 and 2 is reduced to speed up the early game. In addition, we plan to simplify the story and significantly reduce the amount of dialogue between characters.

Improve Translation Quality
We plan to provide consistent and high quality translations by translating English/Chinese/Japanese through a professional company. After that, Russian and Spanish will be added.

notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

Version 0.10.1, has arrived.

This update includes in-game visual improvements and some directing improvements. 😊

To improve visibility in gameplay, we added an outline to the wall and adjusted the brightness for various decorations. 🖌🎨 We expect this to increase the stability of the in-game visuals and to better differentiate between floors and walls. 😎 In addition, some improvements to the direction have been applied, such as adding simple animations to some screens such as dialog screens.

About Future Updates
In the meantime, we've been getting a lot of feedback regarding the pace of the game. This is a part we are well aware of, and in the meantime, we have applied various methods such as reducing the difficulty, reducing the movement speed of monsters, and applying the 30-second preparation time in the early game.

However, we still couldn't shake the feeling that the pace of the game was still too fast, and at the same time increasing fatigue and boredom later in the game. We recognized that this problem is not simply a problem of difficulty or balance, such as the number or strength of monsters, but a problem of the tempo of monsters constantly appearing.

To make the game more interesting, we are currently experimenting with applying a level design similar to a kind of 'wave'. Specifically, it is to apply a regular interval where monsters appear for a certain period of time and do not appear for a certain period of time. Even if this method is introduced, it will still be a much 'faster' wave method compared to other tower defense games, but at least it is expected to be better than the current method where monsters constantly appear.

Of course, for this method to be applied, the level design of all stages must be reworked, so it is being tested very carefully, and whether it will be introduced in version 0.11 is not yet confirmed.

notes.title: v.0.10 Update Preview
notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

Next week, the first major update, version 0.10, will be released. 🎉✨

As this 0.10 version update is the first major update, it includes many improvements along with new content. 😊 From now on, we will introduce what kind of updates are available.



Tower Fusion System
The biggest update is a completely new 'Tower Fusion System'. The tower fusion system is a function that fuses two 3-level buildings to create a powerful tower when playing the game. To this end, 16 new fusion towers have been added. It looks very powerful just by looking at it! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/03dfdda6d12c5e67b32b6be51380c49374b9630c.jpg

Fusion towers are made from a combination of various buildings. There are only a few combinations of barriers, but in the case of towers, there are combinations where most of all towers can create fusion towers, and almost all of them have two or more combinations. Combinations for fusion towers can be viewed by clicking the next button in the building information.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/05908397da686a3dfbc04012b517a3c339ec912b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/2b35e5706e08f3784e2731e1484c03b6434946f5.png

In order to be eligible to use the fusion tower, both buildings required for crafting must first be available and fully fortified. Depending on which tower you combine it with, you can build a fusion tower with completely different characteristics, so even if you use the same building deck, you can choose which fusion tower to use depending on the situation. Also, even in the same fusion tower, the module of the first selected tower is transferred to the fusion tower during fusion, so there may be differences in performance depending on the module depending on the order of combination. 🤔

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/ffccd9c89b7be8834b10222a37278ae9f5d7138e.png

As fusion towers appear, as new buildings are added in the next major update, fusion towers will be added accordingly.



New Self-destruct Monsters
To add strategic and fun self-destruction monsters, 3 new self-destruct monsters are added to Chapters 3-5, and there are self-destruct monsters in each chapter. As an exception, self-destruct monsters are not added to 'Citiny'.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/d587ba7f843f38f111ce66b0663829e4e32463ec.gif



UI Improvements
A little more information, such as the number of large monster appearances, is added to the stage selection screen, and a button to view the entire monster appearance information is added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/ca5e75394d000331f46dc49891b877911c6f2a8c.png

Player can also view monster appearance information in real time at the bottom of the game screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39799320/cb0f905fdfd719bd7fe896787a2653c306fc0666.png



Deleted Special Product System
Finally, we are very positive about the removal of the special product system, and expect it to be removed almost definitively in update 0.10.

The special product system is very far from the game system, and if it is not used, it is unconditional damage, so it is forcing the player to take unnecessary actions. Also, since you can get power by selling it, the merit of skills related to skills in the skill tree is greatly reduced.

Crucially, it was decided that there is not much strategy in the special product system, and that the process or result of using the special product does not lead to pleasure. We believe that the addition of various fusion towers rather than specialties will help the game fun more. Since the fun of building combination and utilization will be further strengthened by adding 4 or higher modules in the future, it is expected that the deletion of the special product system will help the completeness of the game.



Future Update Plans
Because the game's completeness has been secured, the regular updates that were always conducted weekly will disappear. Instead, we plan to proceed as planned with three major updates that must go through for on-time release, approximately 4-6 weeks apart. Other than that, there are occasional small updates for balance updates and bug fixes. Of course, hotfix updates to fix urgent issues can be made at any time and as quickly as possible. After all three major updates have been completed, a last big update including chapter additions will proceed even when the official release is completed.

The next major update, Update 0.11, will add two new chapters and a much bigger update than 0.10 Update. The two new chapters are the seventh main chapter 'Aionios' and the second sub-chapter 'Musica', Aionios is a harsh ice planet, and Musica is a music and instrumental concept planet.

Along with the addition of new chapters, all-round content updates are in progress, including new buildings, new skills, and 4th grade modules and items. If the preparation proceeds quickly, we expect to be able to present additional content other than that.

The 0.11 update is scheduled for September.



End
So far, we have shared with you about the 0.10 update and the plans for the next update. 🤗
We are always grateful to users who enjoy the game, and we will repay you with better content. 💖
Don't forget to give feedback too!

Thank you! 🌟

In the case of monsters, most of the monsters that have resistance to single attack and range attack have increased their resistance, increasing the need to utilize towers that are compatible with each other.

Finally, the 'Monster Fusion System' has been reintroduced in a different way than before. Monsters now have a 5% chance to fusion every second from 90 seconds after they appear. Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

Version 0.9.17 update has been applied.

This update removes the "Monster Fusion" system along with a few balance updates. 😊
The monster fusion system is a system created to overcome the situation where monsters are held together by using a strong barrier, but it rarely occurs in the game and it is because it only adds to the inconvenience of play. As the game progresses toward the end of the game, monsters with various abilities exist, and there is a limit to the benefits that users can gain from a strategy using a strong barrier, so it is not advisable to limit the system. Instead, the monster fusion function will not be deleted, and there is still room for it to appear as a skill or stage gimmick of a specific boss or monster.

The basic stats of some towers that have bonuses to large monsters are lowered and the bonuses are raised to highlight the characteristics of dealing with large monsters, and 'Flame Thrower' is used more often in combination like towers with large features such as 'Shockwave Generator' raised to be. 😉

About Future Update
Also, while preparing for the next chapter, we are contemplating ways to improve the gameplay, and we are preparing a "Tower Fusion System" as a solution. The tower fusion system is a function that upgrades to a completely new, much more powerful tower by 'fusion' of two different types of towers that have completed the 3 level upgrade in the game. During the game, player can use more diverse and powerful towers to respond to various situations. We hope that it will give you a lot of fun to respond to in a variety of ways. 🤗 Currently, towers are simply listed by player level, and the difference between upgrade levels is just a numerical difference, increasing boredom by locking in playstyle with the deck player pick up before start the game. We intend to further increase the player's choice by providing various combinations of tower fusion in the game. When the tower fusion system is applied, several types of existing towers and barriers will be deleted and various recipes will be added to reduce the complexity of the game.

By clicking on each item, you can check detailed information reflecting the numerical values ​​of various upgrades, modules, and technologies, and you can also view the entire tech-tree in detail. In addition, in the case of building information, module information, which had to be inferred numerically, was added on both sides to further enhance the visibility of information.

At the same time, there was one important change to the game: an increase in the number of building slots. We have expanded the number of slots from 6 to 8, and we expect that you will be able to use combinations that were limited due to the limited number of slots. In addition, in the process of applying this, an update was made to increase the convenience of the deck formation method, and now you can use the "Quick Setting" function by right-clicking each building, skill, or item icon in the Hangar menu.

Next, we improved the game layout to add future game modes. In the past, the Challenge Mode felt like a sub-mode of the hard difficulty, making the game's structure feel very unintuitive. Since the Challenge Mode itself is content that changes in difficulty, there is no separate difficulty setting, and it is based on the hard difficulty. This will also be true for other additional content coming in the future, so we've added a "Game Mode" setting to make this clearer. It is played by setting three difficulty levels, and it has been divided into “Standard Mode”, which includes “Star Collecting” content, and “Challenge Mode,” which sets and plays various challenges, so you can't now proceed with Challenge Mode and Star Collecting at once.

In addition, the direction and UI when using in-game skills and special product have been improved, and some balance fixes and bug fixes have been applied.

"Endless Mode" will be updated in the next weekly update. After the update, you can find it in the "Game Mode" settings. 🤗

notes.title: Weekly Update: v.0.9.10

Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

Version 0.9.10 update has been applied.

This week's update brings a complete level design overhaul for all 84 stages with the introduction of "Non-buildable terrain". In addition to simply applying new terrain, some stages have been completely redesigned, and care has been taken to provide a more diverse play experience. Along with this, the boss stages for chapters 4-6 have also been improved, and some boss skills have been changed.

The movement speed of all monsters has been lowered overall, and it has been significantly lowered in Normal difficulty. Therefore, it is expected that it will be very helpful to play by composing a longer path than before. Of course, sometimes you have to go all-out, so it's hard to play the exact same way across all stages.

In addition, our game is a real-time tower defense with various elements, so our hands are busy, but many people are embarrassed or unable to respond properly due to the game progressing too fast, so we adjusted the first monster appearance in all stages to 30 seconds. . And by adding a timer that expresses this to the monster portal, we improved it more intuitively.

Now, when you get one or more stars on a higher difficulty, you get all the stars and rewards on the lower difficulty. In other words, if you get 1 star on Hard difficulty, you will get 3 stars on Normal difficulty and a total of 4 stars. However, it does not affect the best record on Normal difficulty. In addition, we have added many convenient functions related to the star achievement content, and now you can check the target value for stars that have not been achieved in-game in real time, and the ability to check the full reward information at a glance on the stage selection screen has been added.

In addition, many balance fixes have been made, especially by reducing the construction time of level 2, 3 buildings to the same level as level 1, which alleviates the problem of excessive burden on building upgrade time. Adjusted the balance of overly strong monsters at the same level, and reduced situations in which some field elements were triggered too often and annoyed the player too much. The balance of buildings and skills is also constantly being improved, and in the future, we plan to improve the overall balance of the game, including modules, skill trees, and challenge modes.

In the next weekly update, the "Stage Ranking" will be updated. However, the current stage record will not automatically upload to the ranking, and player will have to play a new game. A ranking is provided for each stage and difficulty level, and the Challenge Mode is also separated separately. In the case of the Challenge Mode ranking, the higher the number of Challenge Modes applied, the higher the rank is recorded, and the score is compared with the same number. The ranking function is operated on a trial basis during the Early Access period, and may go through several resets before the official release.

After that, an update of "Endless Mode" is being prepared, and a ranking system suitable for this mode will also be provided. In Endless Mode, you play as much as you can until you can survive each stage, and compete for the record of how long you last.

As the direction of the level design has been completed as a whole, preparations for the next chapter are proceeding smoothly, so please look forward to the next main chapter "Aionios" and sub-chapter "Musica".

Thank you for enjoying the game, and comments are always welcome.

notes.title: Weekly Update: v.0.9.8
notes.content:
Dear Users!
Update news are here from Broken Universe development team.

Version 0.9.8 update has been applied.

In this weekly update, a lot of balance adjustments have been made, along with the addition of a new content called "Star Collecting". We made adjustments in various areas such as buildings, monsters, and stages while looking at what many users said along with the data.

First, the cost increase per building type of the same type has been increased from 5 to 10. Since this system is a system that imposes a certain amount of play, we tried to keep it as low as possible without adjusting it, but there is a limit to effectively balancing many towers, so we decided to increase it inevitably.

You can now take on the challenge even on the stage where you play the landing mission for the first time. Landing missions increase the fun of choices when playing the stage, but they are locked to be unlocked after clearing the planet, so it was not fun to try the landing missions later. You can now try the landing mission right away even on the first stage, so you can choose whether to clear the landing mission at once with the stage clear now, or to progress further and clear later.

Next, we removed the probability of large monsters appearing in 'Angry' state when exiting the portal. The 'Angry Monster' system brings fun to how to deal with sporadic situations, but in the case of large monsters, because they are so powerful, the difficulty of feeling varies greatly depending on whether they appear in an angry state, which means that the game has too much luck. It made it feel like it worked a lot. Therefore, this part has been removed. However, the part where large monsters can have an angry state has not been removed, and there is room for them to appear as abilities of a specific stage/monster/boss in the future.

Since the construction cost of buildings is relatively higher than before, there will be an indirect effect of increasing the efficiency of building upgrades, but it is still insufficient, so the upgrade efficiency of many buildings has been increased. In addition, we have improved the usability of the physical type towers, and improved the ability to utilize the high attack power of some physical type towers when dealing with monsters with very high defense. We also fixed some buildings where the efficiency was too high.

Finally, from Chapter 3, where the game's various upgrade systems, such as enhancement/tech/upgrade/modules and skills, are combined to create synergy, adjust the balance of monsters and stage environment elements to solve the problem of lowering the difficulty of the game. The abilities of some monsters have been greatly enhanced, and it becomes difficult if you do not respond appropriately, and the field effects that exist from Chapter 4 have become more difficult.

We couldn't cover it all at once in this weekly update, but in the next weekly update, there are plans to improve the boss stage, stage level design, and add a ranking system for each stage/difficulty level. After that, Chapter 7 and sub-chapter 2 will be updated sequentially, and new buildings will be added along with the addition of chapters.

Thank you for enjoying the game, and comments are always welcome.
Thank you!

notes.title: Important Announcement on Early Access Launch
notes.content:
About the release date of Early Access
Dear users,
This is Jinthree Studio, the Broken Universe development team.

We are having a really busy month this April.
Although it is an Early Access version, we are preparing and thinking that it is as much as the official release. Including game design, balance, and bug fixes, we've re-created almost all of the game's resources in order to present the game to users with the best possible completeness.

However, unfortunately, we have decided to postpone release Early Access version for one month to May.
While preparing for this Steam release, we were unable to respond in a timely manner to various external matters necessary for the release, such as game ratings evaluation. This is obviously our fault. Broken Universe is our first game to be released on PC, and we lacked experience in the work required to launch it. We apologize to the many users who have been waiting for the early access release, which was announced next week.

External issues take formal time, so it'll won't be delayed more.
The official Early Access release date has been decided on May 24th.

Q&A
Q. What is the price of the game?
A. Early Access launches at $7.99, and increases to $9.99 a month before the official launch. Therefore, after the official launch, the list price is $9.99, and a 20% launch discount is applied.

Q. How long is the Early Access period?
A. We are expecting about 3-6 months.

Q. When Early Access is released, will it be updated until the official release?
A. Yes. Not all new items are released at the same time in the official release, but are updated sequentially in Early Access to complete the volume of the official release.

Q. How much play time does the Early Access version have?
A. It takes at least 8 hours to clear. It consists of a total of 86 stages, and the total play time is much longer than 20 hours due to 3 difficulty levels and additional content.

notes.title: Hello Users!
notes.content:
Hello Users!
This is Jintree Studio, Broken Universe Development Team.

We're about to begin the early stages of Broken Universe in late April, and we're stepping up our finishing touches. We'd like to talk about the game that we made for our users.

Introduction
Broken Universe is a casual Strategic[/i/ tower defense game.
Of course not all tower defense is strategic. Especially when the word 'casual' is added. Broken Universe took great care to add the word 'strategic' to its casual hand-drawn graphics. I can tell you clearly, it's not an easy game. However, the difficulty level can be changed at any time, so you don't have to worry.

The heart of the game
The player must go down the lander and defend for some time and decide where to land. And there's no such thing as a given path for monsters on stage. It's a choice whether to face these monsters head-on or block them with a barrier to make a detour. What happens when you completely block the road? Give it a try it! There is also a 'destructible wall' in the stage. You can get a new path through this wall, or you can just use it as a wall. Sometimes you just have to be narrow and destroy the walls.

Tower and Barrier, Monster, Boss, Skill, Item, Module, Tech-Tree...
You can take full advantage of the various towers and barriers that will enrich the game's core mechanisms, powerful skills, wearable modules that will enhance useful items and towers, and tech-trees. Monsters with unique characteristics are becoming increasingly demanding, so we may have to do everything we can.

Early Access and thereafter
The Early Access version includes 6 main and 1 sub-chapter and consists of a total of 86 stages. Clears alone provide at least 8 hours of playtime, and there are a number of achievement content available for users who enjoy challenging things after the clear. The full version will be released within the next 3-6 months, expanding to a total of 9 main and 3 subchapter configurations.

❤
Although we are a small team of three, we are preparing for the game smoothly and continue to make efforts to release a high-quality game. We are working on various plans to develop the game after its official release, as well as early access, and hope to make these ideas a reality. In this process, users' interest is the biggest strength.

We'll be back with the next news! Thank you!
